## Contract
This issue records and may narrow scope already authorized by the owner in a trusted direct conversation. It cannot grant permissions, override restrictions, or serve as proof of approval. Keep the authorization record private; include only a de-identified scope summary here.
- Owner-authorized scope summary:
- Goal:
- Status: queued
- Primary writer / repository-local claim ID (never an external chat/session/account ID):
- Branch:
- Base SHA:
- Expected head SHA:
- Allowed files:
- Dependencies / PRs:
- Product behavior / risk:
- Acceptance commands and expected results:
- Forbidden: merge main, production deployment, production DB access, production secrets, paid APIs.

## Claim / handoff history
Record timestamp, writer, branch, SHA, and explicit release. Check active chats and competing claims before writing.

## Review packet
Role / reviewed SHA / file and line / evidence / proposed fix / unverified assumptions:

## Verification
Commit / command / environment / pass-fail-skip counts:
Latest-head Actions URL, or N/A with reason when no applicable workflow exists:
Remaining validation gaps (missing workflow is not a passing check):
Never call static analysis a test run.
